title: Entropy increases with dispersal of matter
body: Entropy increases when matter becomes more dispersed (solid to liquid, liquid to gas, gas expanding to a larger volume at constant T, or more moles of gas in products than in reactants).
caution: A bare 'more disorder' statement does not earn credit; name the particles involved and say how they become freer to move (e.g., gas moles increase from reactants to products).
ced_evidence: 9.1.A.1 "Entropy increases when matter becomes more dispersed"
